content.title: What’s open and closed on Easter 2026
content.text: MetroChildren make giant bubbles during an Easter egg hunt at Walter Stinson Community Park in University Heights. The city hosted a community Easter Egg Hunt that included stilt walkers, the Easter Bunny, face painting and other activities for families. Joshua Gunter, cleveland.comBy Staff, cleveland.comAdvance Local Express DeskCLEVELAND, Ohio — Shoppers looking to visit stores on Easter Sunday, April 5, will find many major retailers closed while others operate on reduced schedules as Americans celebrate the holiday.Several big-name retailers are shutting their doors for the day, including Aldi, Target, Costco, Apple, Best Buy, Kohl’s, Macy’s, Nordstrom, and Lowe’s. Other closed stores include J.C. Penney, Dick’s Sporting Goods, Five Below, Michaels, Sephora, Sam’s Club, T.J. Maxx, Marshalls, and lululemon.Among the stores remaining open, most are operating with reduced hours. Walmart will be open from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m., while Meijer operates from 6 a.m. to midnight. BJ’s Wholesale Club runs from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m., and Home Depot opens from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.Several retailers are maintaining limited Sunday schedules, including Barnes & Noble from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m., Old Navy from 10 a.m. to 7 p.m., and Ulta Beauty from noon to 5 p.m. Pet supply stores Petco and PetSmart are also open with reduced hours.Grocery store Giant Eagle will be open but hours will vary by location, while Discount Drug Mart maintains hours from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m.Several pharmacy chains remain open but with hours that vary by location, including CVS, Walgreens, Rite Aid, and Trader Joe’s. Shoppers are advised to check with their local stores for specific hours.Hours listed are based on store websites and retail websites, and customers should confirm their local store hours before visiting.Cuyahoga County Public Library locations and Cleveland Public Library will be closed Sunday. The Monday following Easter is not a federal holiday, so public offices will be open and services such as garbage pickup will not be interrupted.
